content: Tamɣart issɣekkwan d uḥudri
Mmi inu, ḥḍa awařen inu, xemmeř tiweṣṣa inu ɣarek.
Ḥḍa tiweṣṣa inu u cek ad teqqimed teddared, ḥḍa taɣuri inu am mummu n tiṭṭ nnec.
Qqen i-tent ɣar iḍewḍan nnec, ari tent x teřwiḥt n wuř nnec.
Ini i tiɣit: ‘Cem d učma!’, u semma řefhamet: ‘Ameddukkeř inu!’,
maḥend nitenti ad cek ḥḍant zi temɣart tabarranect, zi temɣart zi barra i cek ittɣarran s wawařen nnes.
Maɣar zi řkazi n taddart inu, jar ccebbac n řkazi sewḍeɣ ɣar wadday,
sewḍeɣ ɣar iḥafiyyen inni war ittḥikin, jar iḥenjiren n bnadem ḥekkareɣ ijj n uḥudri s wuř war imten.
Netta iẓwa abrid ɣar teɣmart nnes, u iṭṭef abrid ɣar taddart nnes.
Ɣar tbambast, ɣar tmeddit n wass, di řaǧaɣ n ǧiřet d tubbarcent,
xzar, aqa ict n temɣart tusa-dd i umsagar akides, deg warruḍ n temɣart n farq-ccɣeř u s teḥraymect n wuř.
Nettat textix u tɣewweɣ, iḍaren nnes war qqimen ɛad di taddart.
Ict n twařa di barra, xenni ɛawed deg wazzayen, ɣar marra tiɣemmar n ibriden tᵉttḥama.
Nettat tᵉṭṭef i-t u tessudem i-t, teqjar udem nnes, tenna as:
“Tuɣa xafi maḥend ad wceɣ tiwhibin n řehna. Ass-a ssqefřeɣ lwuɛud inu.
X uya i dd-ffɣeɣ maḥend ad cek mmsagareɣ, maḥend ad xak arzuɣ u ammu i cek ufiɣ.
Necc ssuɣ maltat x qama inu, řizarat izewwqen zi řeqten azdad zi Miṣra.
Necc rucceɣ tassut inu s mirru d wecfiř d řqarfa.
As-dd, ejj aneɣ ad nejjiwen asḥinneb ař tuffut, ejj aneɣ ad narr meẓri di řirart n tayri.
Maɣar aryaz war iǧi di taddart, netta isafar iggʷej aṭṭas.
Iksi ict n tkemmust n tmenyat n nnuqart akides, ad yareggʷeḥ ɣar wass n tziri iqefřen.”
Ammu i t tᵉṭṭef s waṭṭas n řhard nnes, teɣwa i-t s řehrud nnes izewwqen n iyencicen nnes.
Deɣya netta yardef i-tt, am yijj n ufunas igguren ɣar řgurnet, am ict n ssnesřet x iḍaren n wenni igguren ɣar umarret n ubuhaři
- ařami dd as tcarreg fřitca tsa - am yijj n wejḍiḍ iḍwin deg ijj n wenday, u war issin aqa wanita ittwagg ḍidd i tudart nnes.
Xenni řexxu, a iḥenjiren, sřem-dd ɣari, u sřem ɣar wawařen n uqemmum inu.
Ejj uř nnec war ittweddir deg ibriden nnes, war ttmeyyiř ɣar imesraq nnes.
Maɣar deg waṭṭas ittwayezmen inni teɣḍer, imɣar waṭṭas lɛadad n marra inni tenɣa.
Taddart nnes teccur s ibriden ɣar řaxart nni ihekkwan ɣar ixxamen n daxeř n řmewt.
